observations.behavior: Adds LemonSkeleton and ReadOnlyGroupType component, and switches group type selection from LemonSelect to ReadOnlyGroupType when editing an existing group property.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows Customer Analytics configuration to display a loading state and a read-only group type label instead of a dropdown, while retaining the backend's group type index. This could support a backend change that no longer allows editing group type, or a loading state, but the backend implementation is not supplied.
